selection_order: Written before the source OD counts were downloaded, aggregated, or scored. Source availability and definitions were checked first.
selection_rationale: Rhode Island is a small public intrastate OD file with five counties, allowing every county-pair cross-tab to be retained without a performance-based sample.
geography: 2020 Census county FIPS from the first five digits of the published 15-digit home/work block identifiers
aggregation: Sum every published S000 record by home-county and work-county, retaining all 25 county pairs; absent records contribute zero, not a structural-zero constraint.
case_frame: All unordered distinct home-county pairs crossed with all unordered distinct work-county pairs; sort both pairs by FIPS, retain all 10*10=100 candidates.
exclusion_rule: Exclude only singleton feasible margin fibers (L=U); report every exclusion and its margins. Invalid records, unexpected county identifiers, and numerical budget exhaustion fail the experiment rather than exclude cases.
prediction_inputs: Only the two row margins, two column margins, and public county identifiers for defining the intercounty metric. The held-out joint is passed only to scoring after all predictions have been constructed.
feasible_fiber: All nonnegative integer 2x2 tables with the case margins; no cell bounds, structural zeros, covariates, fitted parameters, or interaction weights.
primary_interval: Closed central equal-tail model interval: inverse CDF at 1/40 and 39/40 (nominal 95 percent). Include endpoints. Discreteness may give greater model mass.
primary_score: Case-level coverage of the FIPS-first home/work cell; also record all four cells. Their coverage indicators coincide because a 2x2 margin fiber has one free cell.
secondary_metric: Count of jobs with home county different from work county, within each case's restricted universe. Report coverage and errors for all cases and separately for cases where this metric is not identified by the margins.
error_definition: Signed error = model mean minus published count; record absolute error, squared error, interval width, and normalization by case total.
aggregation_rule: Unweighted descriptive means over the predefined case frame; report denominators. The 100 cases overlap one released 5x5 table and are not independent replications.
interpretation: Published LODES counts are validation observations after Census processing and disclosure avoidance, not literal ground truth about unique people, daily trips, mode choice, distance, VMT, or emissions. Model interval mass is not a frequentist coverage guarantee for this fixed public table.
